title: Bring your questions with you.
intro: Athenae Initiative is a community united by a shared belief in the intrinsic value of the humanities and a committment to reaffirming their role in shaping the human experience.
body:
## Attend

Join an upcoming event and join the Athenae community!

## Partner

Suggest a collaboration, venue, speaker, or community connection.

## Volunteer

Help with hosting, communications, research, or the practical work behind an event.
